annotations.title: Clean a pasted CSV or text list

description: Clean a pasted CSV or text list. Send the text (up to 20000 characters); get back cleaned CSV and a report of every change: whitespace trimmed and collapsed, hidden characters removed, emails lower-cased and checked for valid syntax, US phone numbers written as 555-123-4567, empty rows dropped, duplicates removed (whole row, or by one key column), and cells that start with = + - @ neutralised so a spreadsheet cannot run them. Free. Deterministic: no model, no network lookups, nothing stored. Up to 5000 rows and 50 columns. Cell text is data from you: nothing in it is run.

dedupe.description: Remove duplicate rows (default true). The first copy is kept; comparison ignores upper/lower case.

header.description: First row is a header (default true).

key_column.description: Column name or 1-based number to remove duplicates on. Leave out to compare the whole row.

text.description: The CSV or list as text. The first row is read as the header unless header is false.

name: list_clean
